practiceSets.title: My Village, Binh Yen
practiceSets.description: Learners will read about a girl and her village, practicing comprehension of simple descriptions of people and places.

passage.title: Hello from Binh Yen
passage.content: Hello, my name is Linh. I live in a small village called Binh Yen. It is a beautiful place near a big river. Many houses in Binh Yen have red roofs. My house is next to a green field where farmers grow rice. In the morning, I walk to school with my friend, Mai. We see many cows and chickens on the way. The air is always fresh here. In the evening, my family eats dinner together. My father is a farmer, and my mother works at home. I love my quiet village and my family very much.

options: Linh's daily life in her village

practiceSets.title: My Favorite Breakfast
practiceSets.description: Learners will read about a simple breakfast and practice understanding descriptions of food and drink.

passage.title: A Tasty Start to the Day
passage.content: Every morning, I eat my favorite breakfast. It is a bowl of pho. Pho is a Vietnamese noodle soup. It has long white noodles, slices of beef, and green onions. My mother makes the best pho. She cooks it slowly, so the soup is very tasty. I also drink a glass of orange juice with my pho. Orange juice is sweet and fresh. Sometimes, I eat a small banana after my pho. Breakfast is my favorite meal of the day because it makes me strong and ready for school. I love the warm soup and the sweet juice.

practiceSets.title: My Morning Routine
practiceSets.description: Learners will read about a simple daily routine, practicing comprehension of common actions and time expressions.

passage.title: A Typical Morning
passage.content: Every weekday, I wake up at six o'clock. First, I brush my teeth and wash my face. Then, I put on my school uniform. My mother always makes breakfast for me. I eat rice and eggs, and I drink a glass of milk. At seven o'clock, I say goodbye to my parents and walk to school. School starts at seven thirty. I like my morning routine because it helps me get ready for the day. After school, I come home, do my homework, and play with my dog. It's a busy but good day!

practiceSets.title: My Pet Dog, Lucky
practiceSets.description: Learners will read about a pet dog, practicing comprehension of descriptions of animals.

passage.title: Meet Lucky, My Best Friend
passage.content: I have a pet dog. His name is Lucky. He is a small dog with brown and white fur. Lucky loves to play in the park. Every afternoon, I take him for a walk. He runs very fast and chases the ball. Lucky is a friendly dog. He likes to meet new people and other dogs. At home, Lucky sleeps in a small bed next to my bed. He sometimes barks when he sees a cat outside. Lucky eats special dog food twice a day. He is a very happy dog, and I love him very much. He is my best friend.

practiceSets.title: My Small Family Home
practiceSets.description: Learners will read about a family and their home, practicing comprehension of simple descriptions of family and living spaces.

passage.title: Our Cozy House
passage.content: I live with my family in a small house. There are four people in my family: my father, my mother, my younger sister, and me. Our house has two bedrooms, a living room, and a kitchen. My favorite room is the living room. It has a big window, and I can see our small garden from there. We have a red sofa and a TV in the living room. In the kitchen, my mother cooks delicious meals every day. My sister and I share a bedroom. It has two beds and a big desk for homework. Our house is not big, but it is always warm and full of love.

practiceSets.title: My School Day
practiceSets.description: Learners will read about a typical school day, practicing comprehension of activities and subjects at school.

passage.title: Learning and Fun at School
passage.content: My school starts at 7:30 AM. I go to school with my friends. Our first class is Math. I like Math because numbers are fun. After Math, we have Vietnamese class. We learn to read and write in Vietnamese. At 10:00 AM, we have a short break. I eat a snack and play with my friends in the schoolyard. Then, we have Science class. We learn about animals and plants. Our last class is Art. I love to draw and paint. School finishes at 11:30 AM. I walk home feeling happy because I learn many new things every day.

practiceSets.title: A Rainy Day
practiceSets.description: Learners will read about a rainy day, practicing comprehension of weather and simple natural phenomena.

passage.title: Rainy Day Fun
passage.content: Today is a rainy day. The sky is grey, and big drops of water fall from the clouds. I can hear the rain hitting the roof of my house. It is a little cold outside, so I wear a warm sweater. My mother says we cannot go to the park today. Instead, I stay inside and read my favorite book. My cat, Mimi, is sleeping on the sofa. She likes rainy days too because it is quiet. Sometimes, I look out the window and watch the rain. The trees look very green and clean after the rain. I like rainy days because I can relax at home.

practiceSets.title: My Weekend Hobbies
practiceSets.description: Learners will read about free time activities, practicing comprehension of hobbies and leisure.

passage.title: Fun on Saturdays and Sundays
passage.content: On weekends, I have a lot of free time. My favorite hobby is drawing. I love to draw animals, especially cats and dogs. I use colorful pencils and paper. Sometimes, I draw pictures for my friends. Another hobby is playing football with my friends. We go to the park on Saturday mornings. We run and kick the ball. It is good exercise. On Sunday afternoons, I often read books. I like adventure stories. My mother sometimes takes me to the library to choose new books. Weekends are great because I can do all the things I love!

practiceSets.title: Shopping for Fruit
practiceSets.description: Learners will read about a simple shopping trip, practicing comprehension of buying items and using money.

passage.title: A Trip to the Market
passage.content: Yesterday, my mother and I went to the market. We wanted to buy some fresh fruit. The market was very busy with many people. First, we went to a fruit stall. There were many colorful fruits: red apples, yellow bananas, and green mangoes. I chose some sweet oranges. They cost 20,000 VND for a kilo. My mother bought some juicy watermelons. She paid the seller with a 50,000 VND note. The seller gave her 10,000 VND change. Shopping at the market is fun because everything is fresh and the prices are good. We carried our bags of fruit home happily.

practiceSets.title: My Best Friend, An
practiceSets.description: Learners will read about a best friend, practicing comprehension of descriptions of friends and feelings.

passage.title: A True Friend
passage.content: My best friend's name is An. She is ten years old, just like me. An has long black hair and a big smile. We live in the same neighborhood and go to the same school. An is a very kind person. She always helps me when I have a problem with my homework. She is also very funny. She tells good jokes, and we laugh a lot together. On weekends, we often ride our bikes in the park or read comic books. I feel happy when I am with An. She is a true friend, and I am lucky to have her.
